comment: Steam's Resident Evil (1996), app 4249100 (Capcom with GOG.com, released 2026-04-01; read from the owner's install 2026-10-26, Steam build 21744136). One folder per language beside <appId>_Launcher.exe, whose <appId>_Launcher.ini picks the language and holds the DirectDraw wrapper settings it copies into every folder's dxcfg.ini at each start. Each executable is GOG's inside a wrapper that unpacks it at start; its data folder matches the GOG manifest named here (the English 2,938 of 2,951 files, the Japanese 2,988 of 2,990; the rest are GOG's own extras and dxcfg.exe, which Steam's launcher replaces).
